correctionMethod: For each hardware, new latency(B,EP) = frozen-v13 latency(B,EP) * user-provided ITL(B28,EP8) / frozen-v13 ITL(B28,EP8). Apply the same factor to EP8/16/32. Recompute QPS and 30 ms optimum; preserve capacity assumptions.
limitations: Single-point multiplicative correction, not operator-level fitting or independent validation.
Only the two DP8/EP8 B28 anchors are measured inputs; other batches and DP16/EP16, DP32/EP32 are extrapolations.
Anchor workload used 4096 output tokens; curves retain the original 1024-output QPS convention and assumed ITL/TPOT=3.5.

Baseline capacity/precision assumptions retained: 80% utilization, 4 GiB reserve, 95% physical prefix sharing; 850 INT8 KV and 850E FP8 KV. The recent B28 runtime used FP8 KV on both hardware and different memory-utilization configurations.
Capacity endpoints are inherited model estimates, not validated runtime limits. Effective actual cache hits in B28 were 92.96875%, compared with the baseline 95% assumption.
A whole-curve factor also scales modeled communication latency. Cross-node results are therefore approximate transfers, not communication calibration.
